questions.question: Explain two ways Stresemann improved Germany's international position. (4 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: Through the Locarno Pact (October 1925), which improved relations with France and Britain by guaranteeing western borders, and by joining the League of Nations (September 1926) as a permanent Council member, which restored Germany to equal status in international affairs. Both achievements showed that the policy of "fulfilment" was working.

questions.question: How far did the Dawes Plan solve Germany's economic problems? (8 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: The Dawes Plan helped by reducing annual reparations from £50m to a starting £10m, arranging 800 million gold marks in American loans, and leading to French withdrawal from the Ruhr. Industrial output recovered and employment rose. questions.question: Explain why Weimar culture was controversial. (8 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: Weimar culture was controversial because it challenged traditional values. Bauhaus and New Objectivity art were seen as ugly and "un-German" by conservatives. Cabaret, jazz and liberal attitudes towards sexuality offended traditional moral values. The "New Woman" threatened the traditional family model. Remarque's anti-war novel offended nationalists. Conservatives called it "cultural Bolshevism."

questions.question: "The years 1924-1929 were truly golden for the Weimar Republic." How far do you agree? (16 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: The years 1924-1929 were golden in some respects: the economy recovered, Germany regained international respect, unemployment fell, and culture flourished.
